_documentation.purpose: Lighthouse no-regression baseline for the system-wide-ux-overhaul umbrella. The `lighthouse` CI job compares each route's measured Performance and Accessibility scores against the values stored here; a Performance regression greater than `noRegressionDeltaPoints` (defined in frontend/perf-budgets.json, currently 3) fails the build. See .kiro/specs/system-wide-ux-overhaul/design.md (Lighthouse CI section) and requirements.md R15.1-R15.4, R14.8.
_documentation.placeholderSemantics: A `null` score means the baseline has not yet been recorded for that route. Until a route's baseline is non-null, the no-regression delta gate is skipped for that route and only the absolute floors (performanceMin, accessibilityMin) are enforced.
updateProcedure: 1. The first successful Lighthouse CI run on the main branch after this file lands MUST populate every `null` score by writing the median Performance and Accessibility values from the lhci report.
2. Subsequent updates: open a PR titled 'chore(perf): refresh Lighthouse baseline' that updates the affected route(s) and bumps `lastMeasuredAt` (UTC ISO-8601) and `lastMeasuredCommit` (git SHA).
3. Increases from organic improvement may merge through normal review.
4. Decreases (raising the no-regression floor downward) require explicit reviewer sign-off and a written rationale in the PR description; never silently lower a baseline to make a failing build pass.
5. When adding a new route to the Lighthouse CI matrix (frontend/lighthouserc.json), add a matching entry here with `null` scores in the same PR.
6. When removing a route, delete the entry here in the same PR; never leave stale routes in the baseline.
